newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Stora says hard to raise pulp prices to $580.
newsitem.headline: Stora says hard to raise pulp prices to $580.

text.p: Swedish forestry group Stora said on Thursday it expected it to be difficult to fully raise pulp prices to $580 a tonne from $520 as of May 1.
"It will be difficult to make the full rise in one go," chief executive Lars-Ake Helgesson told a news conference.
He said that increased demand and lower pulp stocks were factors that encouraged the idea of a price hike, he said.
But he said that despite a fall in stocks, North American and Scandinavian pulp stocks (NorScan) were still at a fairly high level.
"On the negative side, Norscan stocks are still high and previous experience tells us it will be hard to raise the price," Helgesson said.
